t: A snap together robotics kit for grades 3-5 coded with VEXcode GO.
steps: Find VEX GO on the VEX site.
Check the device needs for the web version.
Install the VEXcode GO desktop app or open codego.vex.com.
Pair the GO Brain over Bluetooth.
Build one model from the kit.
Read the VEX privacy policy before students sign in.
